contentHtml:
Mumbai: Global pharma major Lupin on Friday said it has launched sitagliptin tablets in the US after the country's health regulator approved its abbreviated new drug application.

The tablets are bioequivalent to the reference listed drug Januvia Tablets of Merck Sharp and Dohme LLC, Lupin said in a regulatory filing.

Sitagliptin tablets USP are indicated for use to improve glycemic control in adults with type-2 diabetes mellitus.

Citing IQVIA MAT September 2026 data, the company said sitagliptin tablets (reference listed drug Januvia) had estimated annual sales of USD 2,328.8 million in the US.

Earlier this week, on November 25, Lupin said the United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) approved the sitagliptin and metformin hydrochloride tablets, 50 mg/500 mg and 50 mg/1,000 mg.

Source : PTI
